product_title: PACLOCK's TL82A Container Lock, Buy American Act Compliant, Blue Anodized Aluminum, High Security 6-Pin Cylinder, One Lock Keyed to a Number U-Pick! w/ 2 Keys, Hidden Shackle
product_description: The TL82A Series is a part of PACLOCK’s Transportation Line of padlocks. One of the big reasons PACLOCK’s “TL” line stands out is the fact that only PACLOCK can create and manufacture lines of padlocks that have the ability to cross key throughout. The TL82A is specifically designed and manufactured for any swinging handle hasp on intermodal containers or connexes. The form-fitting body leaves no shackle to cut and renders the “82” Series impervious to bolt cutters and hacksaws. Beyond increased security, the “82” Series of padlocks feature the PAC-TETHER – a cable that can be crimped to keep the lock fastened to your trailer door – so you’ll never leave it behind. While the TL82A would work on a normal toy-hauler or cargo van hasp, the TL82A’s machined openings are simply too large to provide what PACLOCK considers to be a secure fit. Instead, please consider PACLOCK’s TL81A for those situations. The design of the TL series prevents any type of bolt cutter attack. The body is made from solid, 6061 aluminum billet and then precision machined in PACLOCK’s manufacturing facility. Machining the body versus casting the body is critical because casted bodies can be easily defeated by melting the bodies with an off-the-shelf plumber’s torch. A body that was CNC machined from solid aluminum can hold up to the torch test. Don’t buy die-cast padlocks ever! As with all PACLOCK’s solid body padlocks, the 6-pin cylinder is best in class for pick, bump, rapping, or any other type of surreptitious entry attacks. These locks are guaranteed to have 6-pins and include special “security pins” that thwart would be attacker’s attempts to get into your lock. These security pins are difficult to manufacture which means they cost more and is why your typical retail padlock does not include them. A variety of keying options are available. Please contact PACLOCK if you cannot find the exact configuration you are looking for. Made in USA with global components.
product_bullet_point:
[SR COMPATIBLE] Only compatible with Standard Rekeyable Series locks. If you have or are interested in our UCS Series locks, please search for “UCS-82A”.
[EVERY LOCK, ONE KEY] With PACLOCK, you can use the same key to open your trailer, gate, job box, and more! Order your locks to the same key code to have all of them keyed alike!
[HIGH SECURITY] Ultimate security with bolt cutter-proof hidden shackle design and pick/bump resistant 6-pin cylinder that allows for over 2,800 key codes. Select your own key code and never worry about your neighbor having that same code! Solid 6061 aircraft-grade aluminum body also provides high strength and weatherability!
[INNOVATIVE DESIGN] Designed for shipping containers and connexes. Please measure your application in advance to ensure the lock is the right fit. PAC-BAND keeps dirt, grime, and other elements out of your cylinder, extending the lifespan of your lock, while the PAC-Tether ensures that you'll never lose your lock! Not for toy haulers or trailers - please review the "TL81A" from PACLOCK.
[AMERICAN MANUFACTURER] Made in USA w/ global components by a family manufacturer hiring veterans & people with disabilities. Unbeatable customer support and exceptional lead times as locks are built and shipped within 24-48 hours!

As with our “2173” Series of pucks, the 2177 has special tapped holes on the back allowing the user to affix this padlock directly to a gate, a door, or anything that swings open. Mounting this padlock to the hasp, like PACLOCK’s PL810, means no more lost padlocks because the operator forgot about it! It’s flat-back design is better suited for any “shrouded” hasps that typically stepped-back padlocks are used. The body is precision CNC’d in the US, to within 0.002”, to extreme specifications. Whereas a simple plumbers torch can literally melt The Master Lock Company’s zinc die-cast hockey-pucks, the 2177's body is made from real steal (12L14 cold rolled) that is machined then case hardened and cannot be melted. Couple this lock with a hasp like PACLOCK’s PL810, and you have maximum security. product_description: The “Job-Box-Lock” Series family of products from PACLOCK is the first lock specially designed from the ground up to work with any job box from companies like Knaack or Rigid. The body width, thickness, and length were made to be as form fitting into the box receptacles without causing fitment issues. The shackle length was engineered with specific opening and closing lengths to ensure proper locking and unlocking of the job box. The shackle is made from stainless steel, is then case hardened, and then plated ~ all of this to make the best shackle ever. Toughest in class for strength and best in class for rust resistance. With the “Job-Box-Lock”, gone are the days of padlocks that don’t work in your job box; gone are the days of your padlock being hard to close; gone are the days of not being able to buy multiples of padlocks with the same keys. With PACLOCK’s “Job-Box-Lock” you can truly have it all. The body is precision CNC’d in the USA and the locking mechanism is a dual ball bearing, “toe and heel,” design providing significantly better pull-force strength compared to typical “lever-lock” padlocks. The ball bearings also provide a far smoother and easier to lock/unlock experience. Gone are the days of shoving your padlock against the Job-Box to get it locked. The 6-pin cylinder is best in class for pick, bump, rapping, or any other type of surreptitious entry attacks. These locks are guaranteed to have 6-pins and include special “security pins” that thwart would be attacker’s attempts to get into your lock. The shackle is one of a kind “Hardened Stainless Steel” shackle. Introduced in 2019, PACLOCK is the first company to ever offer a stainless-steel shackle that’s been hardened and then nickel plated to give the consumer the best of both worlds ~ strong, and as rust-proof as you can get. A variety of keying options are available. Please contact PACLOCK if you cannot find the exact configuration you are looking for. Made in USA with global components.

product_description:
Do you find it difficult to give your small child or pet medicine? Are they constantly spitting out the medicine, creating a mess and making it impossible for you to know how much medicine they actually received? With these Brandzig Oral Dispenser Syringes, your struggles will finally be over.

Sold in a 100-count box, this sufficient supply is ideal for doctors, clinics, hospitals, pharmacies and home use. They’re available in 1-, 3-, 5- and 10-ml capacities, allowing you to efficiently administer medication to infants, children and small pets. Unlike feeding medicine with a spoon or cup, this oral dispenser sends the medicine to the side of the cheek, bypassing the taste buds to reduce the chances of spit-ups and messes.

It is safe for use, each syringe is expertly made from medical grade plastic without latex to eliminate allergic reactions. The syringe is translucent for easy visibility, calibrated in both teaspoons and milliliters to allow for accurate measurements so you can deliver the proper dosage of medication.

Individually sealed to ensure it’s clean and sterile, each disposable syringe is designed for one-time use only for sanitation purposes. Syringes can also be used for various projects which require small measurements or precise application.
